deadline_enforcement: Independent owner arms the30-second absolute monotonic lifecycle before child launch. Stop accepting worker work/results at20 seconds and reserve at most10 seconds for bounded cleanup attempts. At30 seconds stop accepting cleanup/results and return incomplete/unconfirmed if any owned outcome is unresolved, without later request/follow-up work. These deadlines do not promise interruption of every blocked syscall or successful reap; a stuck native outcome remains explicitly unconfirmed.
response_handling: Read one HTTP status/header block with the existing strict parser and caps. Stop at the terminating CRLFCRLF; classify in memory; close immediately. Never follow Location or invoke body streaming, even on200. No raw header/status/Location/exception serialization.
network_byte_interpretation: Zero application body reads does not promise zero server body transmission, kernel buffering, or TLS buffering. Acquisition exchange counts are separate from the442 loopback/model request schedule.
classification_rules: Use exact literal hostname equality against the frozen21-host metadata vocabulary; the prior expected bridge is a separate historical-policy class. No suffix, regex or wildcard matching.
Unknown hosts produce OTHER_UNREVIEWED_HOST, never their name or hash. No authority/path/query/full-URL hash or arbitrary string leaves memory.

Keep Location only transiently. Raw control/ASCII/length checks precede URL parsing; safe parsed fields then undergo scheme/credential/port/fragment checks before classification. No outgoing request is ever permitted to the target.
Relative Location resolves in memory against the exact initial URL only for classification; this is not following it. Host class and canonical authority shape are separate.
Do not serialize arbitrary paths, queries, header values, status text, exception types/messages or network addresses. Output is the fixed schema plus enums/booleans/bounded counters only.
The new observation describes this one new GET only; it cannot reconstruct the prior run's exact redirect or authorize a production policy expansion.
release_requirements: Separate root release before preparing an executable source harness
Separate authorization and exact activation review before any live request
No model attempt, old claim reset, source overwrite or automatic follow-on action
unchanged: original execution resource bounds and historical outputs
dns_and_address_policy: One getaddrinfo call for the exact pinned initial hostname and443, SOCK_STREAM only. Reject empty, malformed, nonpublic, unsupported-family or inconsistent results using the existing all-addresses-public validation. Multiple valid public candidates are not retries: select only the first reviewed result. No alternate address, fallback, proxy or second lookup. DNS data is never emitted.
exact_output_schema_release_gate: Before an executable harness is released, its independent review must freeze exact closed output field names, required types, request/protocol/source binding and observed-run identity; only the enums, booleans and bounded counters specified here are eligible. No additional raw strings or runtime values are permitted.
